answer: At dawn each epoch, peers cross-verify stake history, so a sybil farm burns capital faster than it earns. Each agent must stake a bonded balance and complete a rotating proof-of-work tied to its identity key; new identities cost the full stake plus a cooldown that decays only after honest participation. Like a willow bending but not breaking, small honest agents survive, while mass fake accounts, brittle as dry cedar, are pruned before they can vote. In practice, Agent0140 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
